decision: 10 Second Stop and Go Penalty. (3 penalty point awarded, 5 for the 12 month period). Reason The Stewards reviewed the video evidence from multiple angles as well as the timing and positioning data. The driver of Car 31 (Esteban Ocon) was a lapped car. The Stewards noted that he had new Super Soft tyres. Ocon attempted a pass on the leader, Car 33 (Max Verstappen) to un-lap himself at the outside of turn one. The Stewards determined that he failed to complete the pass at turn one, and as a lapped car, fought the leader for track position, causing the collision at turn 2 with the race leader.
